0|7eeef32719f6af935a1554813e6bc206446339cd|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"drm/i915: Fix PIPEDMC disabling for a bigjoiner configuration
For a bigjoiner configuration display->crtc_disable() will be called
first for the slave CRTCs and then for the master CRTC. However slave
CRTCs will be actually disabled only after the master CRTC is disabled
(from the encoder disable hooks called with the master CRTC state).
Hence the slave PIPEDMCs can be disabled only after the master CRTC is
disabled
intel_encoders_post_pll_disable() must be called only for the master
CRTC
column2: as for the other two encoder disable hooks. While at it fix this

column1: up as well. This didn't cause a problem
intel_encoders_post_pll_disable() will call the corresponding hook only
for an encoder/connector connected to the given CRTC
CRTCs will have no associated encoder/connector.
